_comment: State for the hourly Drive image check. Each entry records the Google Drive
file id that produced the assets currently committed under
public/assets/images/bt/photos, so a re-upload is detectable: Drive gives a
replaced file a NEW id, and the listing also carries its size and upload
time. If the id for a name differs from the one here, the image was
replaced and needs reprocessing; a name absent here is a new image.
Pipeline for every photograph: crop to the aspect its slot renders at,
resample in halving steps, export WebP at quality 0.90, at 1x and 2x of the
rendered CSS size. Never ship the Drive original - they are 2.5-3.8 MB JPEGs.
Names are matched case- and space-insensitively: the same two images have
`driveName` records what the folder last called each one.
